title: Xingcheng native-only language boundary
summary: Restrict Xingcheng to C, C++23, C#, F# and Rust and exclude external execution dependencies.

changes.proposed: XINGCHENG-NATIVE-ONLY:the complete Xingcheng source,production runtime,training,inference,learning,evaluation,data-processing and internal-tool surface uses only C+C++23+CSharp+FSharp+Rust;this is a strict Xingcheng-specific subset and no project-wide language permission expands it;OWNERSHIP:C and Rust own deterministic runtime+lifecycle+security+data hot paths,C++23 solely owns model training+inference+artifact production,CSharp owns bounded application+workflow orchestration,FSharp owns evaluation+validation+high-correctness analysis;EXCLUDED:Go+JavaScript+Bun+WebView script+Python and every other source or execution language are prohibited inside Xingcheng;EXTERNAL-DEPENDENCY:no external model+cloud service+external execution engine+third-party inference framework+third-party training framework+external capability service may be a Xingcheng runtime,producer,consumer,reference,fallback or authority;PLATFORM-BOUNDARY:operating-system facilities+hardware drivers+approved build toolchains+governed typed channels may provide platform boundaries only and gain no Xingcheng capability,model,data or authority ownership;TRAINING remains an internal Xingcheng service capability and not an independent module or tool;MODEL_TRAINING remains retired;FAILURE:any excluded language,external capability dependency or unregistered executor is denied fail-closed.
